Stage 3 pins candidate tools and validates inventory semantics/content; full builds and behavior belong to downstream tasks.

handoff.source_of_truth: Issue #1 factual source inventory; Issue #3 owns product contract schemas.
handoff.record_validity: Stage 1/2 JSON, identity, reference and bounded source-content checks are not the Stage 3 inventory validator or audit acceptance. A valid needs-port or blocked record cannot establish runtime eligibility.

evidence_reference_resolution: Resolve evidence_refs against unique evidence definition records in evidence_documents; objects containing only evidence_id and lines are citations. Legacy section-key references resolve only in evidence_document (Stage 1). Stage 2 group records name their exact top-level section. Stage 1 records remain historical acquisition evidence.

source_requirements.title: ARM64 loader and low-address reservation
source_requirements.reusable_source: Wine accepts aarch64/ARM64EC PE build targets and has host loader/reservation code. The selected aarch64 configuration does not select the old Mac preloader.
source_requirements.remaining_work: Define the native loader layout, signed app launch and process creation strategy using the measured host facilities. The inspected Wine configuration requests a 4 KiB PAGEZERO (-pagezero_size,0x1000), whereas the qualified Issue #2 probe used the emulation layout with a protected 64 KiB PAGEZERO; reconcile and verify the actual loader rather than copying either blindly. The unsupported-CPU branch in the optional preloader is not itself proof that every ARM64 build must use or port that preloader.
source_requirements.future_verification: Inspect actual ARM64 Mach-O layout; reserve/map the required low address ranges before PE loading; verify each required child uses the intended layout under normal protections.

source_requirements.title: Guest/host x18 transitions and callbacks
source_requirements.reusable_source: Wine ARM64 assembly saves/restores x18 and provides syscall/callback entry points; Apple ARM64 signal context definitions already exist.
source_requirements.remaining_work: Integrate explicit custom-x18 mode transitions before ordinary macOS calls, restore guest state only after foreign-mode entry, and cover nested callbacks, error exits and asynchronous entry. Exact new Apple API spellings were not found in the selected tracked trees; this is not a claim about all branches or alternate implementations.
source_requirements.future_verification: Exercise native/translated calls in both directions, nested callbacks, host logging/allocation, signal entry and error exits while checking x18/mode restoration; finite Issue #2 thunks do not qualify these runtime paths.

source_requirements.title: 4 KiB guest memory and process page geometry
source_requirements.reusable_source: Wine distinguishes its 4 KiB page bookkeeping from the aarch64 host page size and contains protection/commit paths.
source_requirements.remaining_work: Wire process creation to the selected 4 KiB user-page mode and reconcile reserve/protect/decommit/recommit/guard behavior with Wine and FEX. Host probe success does not change the selected source automatically.
source_requirements.future_verification: Verify 4 KiB geometry for actual runtime children, independent adjacent-page protection/faults/recommit, low mappings and Windows allocation edge cases.

source_requirements.title: Wine ARM64EC/WoW64 translator interfaces
source_requirements.reusable_source: Wine loads an ARM64EC emulator module, obtains lifecycle/memory/exception callbacks, and has the separate WoW64 BTCpu interface. FEX supplies Windows module lifecycle, context reconstruction and Wine UnixLib loading code.
source_requirements.remaining_work: Select matching module/UnixLib names, exports and versions; integrate the host ports and prove actual FEX selection. The Wine source tag used for DXMT linking is not a functioning runtime according to its publisher.
source_requirements.future_verification: Load an identifiable FEX module into native ARM64 Wine and run x64 plus required x86 smoke tests with explicit module/process attribution and no Rosetta fallback.

source_requirements.title: FEX native host service boundary
source_requirements.reusable_source: FEX Windows UnixLib has a small function-table boundary for memory-model policy, mapping, advisory controls and statistics; the Windows module avoids requiring the full Linux application loader.
source_requirements.remaining_work: Implement a Darwin host side or explicitly disable optional facilities with correct errors. The selected UnixLib includes sys/prctl.h, calls Linux prctl operations, emits .so targets and links rt; it is not a ready Darwin implementation.
source_requirements.future_verification: Build and inspect native ARM64 host libraries; validate every used UnixLib call, mapping/file lifetime, optional capability refusal and cleanup from the real Windows module.

source_requirements.title: Per-thread x86 ordering and software fallback
source_requirements.reusable_source: FEX has a configurable software TSO path and a hardware-support switch; its Windows boundary attempts hardware TSO through UnixLib.
source_requirements.remaining_work: The inspected UnixLib implements Linux prctl policy, while macOS requires a separate per-thread policy operation. FEX disables several software-emulation paths when hardware support is selected; do not set a context-wide hardware flag unless all participating threads satisfy the policy or retain a correct fallback.
source_requirements.future_verification: Check each actual thread initialization/error/cleanup path, distinguish API return from finite behavior, and test software fallback and unaligned/atomic behavior without treating zero finite litmus outcomes as a universal proof.

source_requirements.title: Executable code allocation, cache visibility and invalidation
source_requirements.reusable_source: FEX uses Windows allocation/protection APIs, EC-code attributes and memory invalidation callbacks; Wine contains instruction-cache and guest memory machinery.
source_requirements.remaining_work: Specify the macOS JIT code-cache allocation/write/execute/cache-flush/lifetime contract with signing. The selected source does not contain the exact MAP_JIT or pthread_jit_write_protect_np tokens searched. Do not replace every PE or guest RWX mapping with MAP_JIT indiscriminately.
source_requirements.future_verification: Run translated code generation, code patching/self-modification, fault-triggered invalidation, concurrent execution/reclamation and required cache flushes through actual Wine/FEX under verified entitlements.

source_requirements.title: Signals, exceptions, suspension and guest reconstruction
source_requirements.reusable_source: Wine has Apple ARM64 integer/FPU signal-context handling, signal registration and syscall fault handling. FEX reconstructs guest state and handles access/guard/invalidation cases.
source_requirements.remaining_work: Audit the new host ABI gateway through actual POSIX/Mach faults, Windows SEH/unwind and asynchronous suspend/resume. Existing code and Issue #2 controlled SIGUSR1/error-return probes are not a complete Windows exception proof.
source_requirements.future_verification: Exercise fault address/PC, nested SEH, stack unwind, guard pages, interrupt/suspend and precise translated-state resumption across host/guest callbacks.

source_requirements.title: DXMT/Wine graphics export and structure compatibility
source_requirements.reusable_source: DXMT supports both a macdrv_functions table and individual-symbol fallback. An existing public Wine export patch is available and its original application was reproduced.
source_requirements.remaining_work: The patch does not apply to either selected Wine tree. More importantly, DXMT expects a window-data structure prefix with cocoa_view and client_cocoa_view, while both selected Wine headers have client_view followed by rects. Exporting names alone does not repair that layout contract.
source_requirements.future_verification: Define and implement a matching driver ABI, then test window creation, device/presentation, resize, teardown, repeated view lifetime and callback transitions using open x64 D3D11 programs.

source_requirements.title: ARM64EC PE plus native Metal/shader components
source_requirements.reusable_source: DXMT has ARM64EC cross settings, native ARM64 LLVM shader build rules, matching Wine-linked winemetal pieces and native Metal callback code.
source_requirements.remaining_work: Reconcile LLVM 15 shader-library and LLVM-MinGW compiler roles, exact tool/SDK inputs and native/PE output pairing; audit callbacks such as Metal shared-event delivery into NtSetEvent for the chosen Wine ABI mode.
source_requirements.future_verification: Reproduce builds and inspect headers/dependencies, then validate shaders/readback/synchronization/presentation and callback mode correctness before game qualification.
